title: EmbodiedMidtrain: Bridging the Gap between Vision-Language Models and Vision-Language-Action Models via Mid-training
abstract: arXiv:2604.20012v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision-Language-Action Models (VLAs) inherit their visual and linguistic capabilities from Vision-Language Models (VLMs), yet most VLAs are built from off-the-shelf VLMs that are not adapted to the embodied domain, limiting their downstream performance. In this work, we propose EmbodiedMidtrain to bridge the gap between VLMs and VLAs. We first characterize the data distribution gap between them, showing that VLA data occupy compact regions that are largely separated from the broader VLM distribution, while the degree of alignment varies substantially both across and within VLM data sources. Then, we build a mid-training data engine that leverages a lightweight learnable proximity estimator to select the most VLA-aligned candidates from a large VLM pool, and produce EmbodiedMidtrain-1M, a VLM dataset that we further use to mid-train the VLM before downstream VLA fine-tuning. Experiments on both simulated robot manipulation bench

translated_title: EmbodiedMidtrain：通过中期训练弥合视觉-语言模型与视觉-语言-动作模型之间的差距
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）从视觉-语言模型（VLM）继承了其视觉和语言能力，然而大多数VLA是基于现成的VLM构建的，这些VLM并未针对具身领域进行适配，从而限制了其下游性能。在本工作中，我们提出EmbodiedMidtrain来弥合VLM与VLA之间的差距。我们首先刻画了二者之间的数据分布差距，表明VLA数据占据了与更广泛的VLM分布大体分离的紧凑区域，而对齐程度在不同的VLM数据源之间以及同一数据源内部存在显著差异。随后，我们构建了一个中期训练数据引擎，利用轻量级的可学习邻近度估计器从大型VLM数据池中筛选出与VLA最对齐的候选数据，构建了EmbodiedMidtrain-1M数据集，并进一步使用该数据集对VLM进行中期训练，之后再进行下游的VLA微调。在仿真机器人操作基准等实验中的结果验证了该方法的有效性。
tldr: 该论文提出EmbodiedMidtrain方法，通过可学习邻近度估计器从大规模VLM数据池中筛选与VLA数据分布最对齐的样本，构建百万规模数据集EmbodiedMidtrain-1M对VLM进行中期训练，从而弥合视觉-语言模型与视觉-语言-动作模型之间的差距并提升下游VLA性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes EmbodiedMidtrain, which uses a lightweight learnable proximity estimator to select the most VLA-aligned candidates from a large VLM pool to build the EmbodiedMidtrain-1M dataset for mid-training VLMs, bridging the gap between Vision-Language Models and Vision-Language-Action Models and improving downstream VLA performance.
